==Notes==
{{anomaly|Contrary to what the concise description suggests, this is not a [[melee attack]], but a spear attack with [[touch]] range. Skills such as [[Strength of Honor]] will not trigger. [["Can't Touch This!"]] will protect against this skill.}}
*The [[AI]] will use this skill as a normal attack skill, regardless of the Daze effect or melee range requirement.

== Trivia ==
* The figure in the [[skill icon]] appears to be wearing [[Paragon Ancient armor]].
* This and [[Spear of Fury]] are the only spear attack skills not tied to [[Spear Mastery]].
